agents.description: Full resource names (project number) and identity per deployed agent.

expected_agent_principal_set.description: Principal set the platform is expected to bind roles/aiplatform.agentDefaultAccess to (T40).

id.description: Fully qualified GEAP Agent Runtime id.

agent_runtime_config.description: The agent configuration. Supported values for agent_framework: 'google-adk', 'langchain', 'langgraph', 'ag2', 'llama-index', 'custom'.

enable_deletion_protection.description: Whether deletion protection should be enabled.

encryption_key.description: The full resource name of the Cloud KMS CryptoKey.

managed.description: Whether the Terraform module should control the code updates.

project_id.description: The id of the project where to deploy the agent.

region.description: The region where to deploy the agent.

custom_role_id.description: Map of custom role IDs created in the project.

custom_roles.description: Map of custom roles resources created in the project.

default_service_accounts.description: Emails of the default service accounts for this project.

organization_policies_ids.description: Map of ORGANIZATION_POLICIES => ID in the organization.

scc_custom_sha_modules_ids.description: Map of SCC CUSTOM SHA MODULES => ID in the project.

service_agents.description: List of all (active) service agents for this project.

services.description: Service APIs to enable in the project.

sink_writer_identities.description: Writer identities created for each sink.

auto_create_network.description: Whether to create the default network for the project.

bigquery_reservations.description: BigQuery reservations and assignments. Assignment specified as {JOB_TYPE = ['projects/PROJECT_ID']}.

compute_metadata.description: Optional compute metadata key/values. Only usable if compute API has been enabled.

contacts.description: List of essential contacts for this resource. Must be in the form EMAIL -> [NOTIFICATION_TYPES]. Valid notification types are ALL, SUSPENSION, SECURITY, TECHNICAL, BILLING, LEGAL, PRODUCT_UPDATES.

custom_roles.description: Map of role name => role attributes to create in this project.

default_network_tier.description: Default compute network tier for the project.

default_service_account.description: Project default service account setting: can be one of `delete`, `deprivilege`, `disable`, or `keep`.

deletion_policy.description: Deletion policy setting for this project.

descriptive_name.description: Descriptive project name. Set when name differs from project id.

factories_config.description: Paths to data files and folders that enable factory functionality.

iam_bindings.description: Authoritative IAM bindings in {KEY => {role = ROLE, members = [], condition = {}}}. Keys are arbitrary.

iam_bindings_additive.description: Individual additive IAM bindings. Keys are arbitrary.

iam_by_principals.description: Authoritative IAM binding in {PRINCIPAL => [ROLES]} format. Principals need to be statically defined to avoid errors. Merged internally with the `iam` variable.

iam_by_principals_additive.description: Additive IAM binding in {PRINCIPAL => [ROLES]} format. Principals need to be statically defined to avoid errors. Merged internally with the `iam_bindings_additive` variable.

iam_by_principals_conditional.description: Authoritative IAM binding in {PRINCIPAL => {roles = [roles], condition = {cond}}} format. Principals need to be statically defined to avoid errors. Condition is required.

iam_deny_policies.description: IAM Deny policies to be applied to the project.

lien_reason.description: If non-empty, creates a project lien with this description.

logging_data_access.description: Control activation of data access logs. The special 'allServices' key denotes configuration for all services.

logging_exclusions.description: Logging exclusions for this project in the form {NAME -> FILTER}.

logging_sinks.description: Logging sinks to create for this project.

metric_scopes.description: List of projects that will act as metric scopes for this project.

network_tags.description: Network tags by key name. If `id` is provided, key creation is skipped. The `iam` attribute behaves like the similarly named one at module level.

org_policies.description: Organization policies applied to this project keyed by policy name.

pam_entitlements.description: Privileged Access Manager entitlements for this resource, keyed by entitlement ID.

parent.description: Parent folder or organization in 'folders/folder_id' or 'organizations/org_id' format.

prefix.description: Optional prefix used to generate project id and name.

project_reuse.description: Reuse existing project if not null. If name and number are not passed in, a data source is used.

scc_mute_configs.description: SCC mute configurations keyed by name.

scc_sha_custom_modules.description: SCC custom modules keyed by module name.

service_agents_folder_bindings.description: Additive IAM bindings for this project's service agents on external folders, in key => binding format.

service_agents_project_bindings.description: Additive IAM bindings for this project's service agents on external projects, in key => binding format.

service_encryption_key_ids.description: Service Agents to be granted encryption/decryption permissions over Cloud KMS encryption keys. Format {SERVICE_AGENT => [KEY_ID]}.

shared_vpc_host_config.description: Configures this project as a Shared VPC host project (mutually exclusive with shared_vpc_service_project).

shared_vpc_service_config.description: Configures this project as a Shared VPC service project (mutually exclusive with shared_vpc_host_config).

tag_bindings.description: Tag bindings for this project, in key => tag value id format.

tags.description: Tags by key name. If `id` is provided, key or value creation is skipped. The `iam` attribute behaves like the similarly named one at module level.

tags_config.description: Fine-grained control on tag resource and IAM creation.

universe.description: GCP universe where to deploy the project. The prefix will be prepended to the project id.

vpc_sc.description: VPC-SC configuration for the project, use when `ignore_changes` for resources is set in the VPC-SC module.

workload_identity_pools.description: Workload Identity Federation pools and providers.

agent_source_path.description: ONE source tarball used for all three agents (tests/fixtures/agent_v3/build.sh writes it; path relative to infra-v3h/; record sha256).

base_state_path.description: Path to the infra/ local state, read for folder_ids.ai_prod.

billing_account.description: Billing account ID for the run project. No default.

deploy_agent_3.description: Deploy agent 3 (T43, after agents 1 and 2 are deleted).

existing_project_id.description: Use this existing project instead of creating prj-lzv-v3-<run> (2026-11-11: r1 PROJECT_9, r2 -data, r3 -outside). It must never have hosted an agent (no agentDefaultAccess binding).

model.description: Model id passed to the agent as LZV_MODEL.

operator_member.description: IAM member string for the operator that deploys agents, e.g. user:NAME@example.com. Granted var.operator_roles additively. No default.

operator_roles.description: Roles granted to the operator (additive, google_project_iam_member). Must NOT contain roles/aiplatform.* so the T42 Rego gate stays a clean test of out-of-band grants (roles/editor already carries the Vertex AI permissions needed to create reasoning engines).

org_id.description: Numeric organization ID. Used only to build the expected agent principalSet string. No default.

prefix.description: Project ID prefix (same as infra/). Max 14 chars.

quota_project.description: Existing project used for API quota/billing of provider calls (the seed project). No default.

region.description: Region for agents. T40-T43 default europe-west1; run 3 may use europe-west4.

run.description: Run label, for example r1. Project name becomes prj-lzv-v3-RUN.

t40b_authoritative.description: T40b: add authoritative google_project_iam_binding for roles/aiplatform.agentDefaultAccess with members = []. Turn on only after agent 1 works.
